outcome: Expression of germ cell-specific markers (c-Kit, DDX4, Piwil2, Dazl genes)
cohort: Human umbilical Wharton's jelly-derived mesenchymal stem cells (HWJMSCs) were obtained from the umbilical cords of male neonates delivered by cesarean section.
finding: Induction of HWJMSCs with TCC in the presence of RA, and also BMP signaling, significantly upregulated male germ cell-specific genes, indicating differentiation into male germ cells in vitro.
